# Holded

Holded is business management software for managing sales documents, invoices, services, contacts, contact groups, and tags.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/holded/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Create a customer, supplier, lead, debtor, creditor, or unclassified contact and return its new Holded ID.
- **Create Invoice**: Create a sales invoice for an existing contact and return its ID.
- **Delete Contact**: Permanently delete one contact by ID.
- **Delete Invoice**: Permanently delete one invoice and its recorded payments.
- **Find Contacts** (read-only): Find Holded contacts by name prefix or an exact email, phone, mobile, tax ID, or external ID.
- **Find Invoices** (read-only): Find Holded invoices by fuzzy document-number prefix or list them by contact, payment status, issue date, or due date.
- **Get Contact** (read-only): Return the complete profile of one contact by its Holded contact ID.
- **Get Invoice** (read-only): Return full details, lines, totals, and payment summary for one invoice by its Holded ID.
- **Update Contact**: Safely change selected fields on a contact without clearing unspecified profile data.
- **Update Invoice**: Safely change selected mutable fields on an invoice without clearing unspecified invoice data or altering recorded payments.
